newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China ministry not in talk to buy HK Telecom - paper.
newsitem.headline: China ministry not in talk to buy HK Telecom - paper.

text.p: China's Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications said it and subsidiaries had never contacted Cable and Wireless Plc or Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd about buying shares in the latter.

The Hong Kong Economic Journal reported on Thursday that Lin Jinquan, a Vice-Minister of the Ministry which overseas China's telecommunications industry, said in Beijing he knew nothing about talk that the British telecoms group might sell some HK Telecom shares to mainland Chinese.

It was inappropriate for China to take the initiative to propose an acquisition of shares in Hongkong Telecom, Lin was quoted as saying when asked if China would be interested in buying a stake in the Hong Kong telecoms firm in the future.
Officials at the Ministry were not immediately available to comment on the report.

This week, Britain's Sunday Telegraph said HK Telecom was likely to pass into Chinese hands, with Cable and Wireless set to slash its 58.6 percent stake to below 50 percent in return for better access to the Chinese telecoms markets.
HK Telecom had earlier dismissed the Sunday Telegraph report as "gossip".
